crossRefs.note: The pavement was by the side of the gates, corresponding to the length of the gates, even the lower pavement.

translations.web: The pavement was by the side of the gates, corresponding to the length of the gates, even the lower pavement.
translations.bsb: which flanked the gateways and corresponded to the length of the gates; this was the lower pavement.
translations.kjv: And the pavement by the side of the gates over against the length of the gates was the lower pavement.
translations.asv: And the pavement was by the side of the gates, answerable unto the length of the gates, even the lower pavement.
